newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico department store sales up, self-service off.
newsitem.headline: Mexico department store sales up, self-service off.

text.p: Mexico's department store sales rose 4.4 percent in January compared with the same month last year, but self-service sales sales fell 5.5 percent, the Association of Department Stores said on Tuesday.
Antad said department sales of clothing and "white goods" consumer durables grew 4.1 percent and 23.4 percent, respectively, while the "various" items fell 9.6 percent.
In the self-service sector, supermarket sales dropped 6.7 percent and gerneral merchanise was off 4.0 percent. Clothing was off 0.4 percent.
